text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills edged up from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills rose to 24.47 percent from 24.38 percent, six-month bills firmed to 31.30 percent from 30.22 percent, nine-month bills edged up to 34.86 percent from 34.82 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.93 percent from 39.91 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.71 million UAH 4.71 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 31,555 were competitive and 18,445 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 10.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 8.00 million UAH
Amount sold 63.64 million UAH 6.07 million UAH
Actual amount raised 55.05 million UAH 5.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 636,363 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 634,547 were competitive and 1,816 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 10.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 30.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 29.07 million UAH 4.13 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.05 million UAH 3.28 million UAH
The central bank sold 290,667 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 290,657 were competitive and 10 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 10.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 95.67 million UAH 6.05 million UAH
Actual amount raised 68.42 million UAH 4.33 million UAH
The central bank sold 956,706 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 946,164 were competitive and 10,542 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 10.
